meta_title: Reading Journal App for iPhone | BookWorm
meta_desc: A reading journal that keeps itself: notes pinned to the page you wrote them on, a calendar of every reading day, and each book you finish.
og_title: A reading journal that keeps itself
og_desc: Notes pinned to the page, a calendar of reading days, and every book you've finished.
h1: A book journal that keeps itself.
lede: Write a thought on page 142 and it stays on page 142. BookWorm keeps your notes, your reading days and every book you finish, so the journal writes itself while you read.
shot_alt: My Bookshelf with Reading, To Read and Finished tabs.
shot2_alt: The BookWorm reading calendar with 18 reading days and a 16-day streak.
points_lede: Everything a paper book journal asks you to copy out by hand, kept as you go.
p1_d: Each note remembers the page, or the minute of an audiobook, where you wrote it. A book's notebook reads in page order, and you can search it.
p2_d: Every day you read gets a mark and every book you finish gets a gold ring. Tap a day to see what you read.
p3_d: Start and finish dates, pauses, re-reads, genres and favourites. Your shelf filters by year, format and genre, so last summer's books are one tap away.
p4_d: On the first of the month, BookWorm shows what you read the month before. Finished books can be shared as a vintage library checkout card.
deep_title: Write while you read, not after.
deep_p1: The best line in a book is easiest to keep in the moment you read it. Start a reading session, and a note is one tap away without leaving the timer. Close the session without logging pages and your notes still stay.
deep_p2: Your journal is yours: it syncs through your own iCloud account, and you can export the whole library, notes included, from Settings at any time.
deep_link: Read the guide to starting a reading journal
q1: Is BookWorm a reading journal or a reading tracker?
a1: Both. It tracks your page, your goal and your streak, and it keeps the journal side: notes on each book, the days you read, and when you started and finished.
q2: Can I write notes on audiobooks?
a2: Yes. A note on an audiobook is pinned to the hour and minute you were at, the same way a note on a paper book is pinned to a page.
a3: Yes. Each book's notebook has a search field that looks through the text of your notes and their pages.
q4: Can I get my journal out of the app?
a4: Yes. Settings has Export Data, which saves your whole library, reading history and notes as a file you keep. Import reads it back.
q5: I like writing by hand. Is there a paper version?
a5: There's a printable reading log on the reading log page, with a page for your books, a year of reading days and a page for notes.
